alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1, even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n

gb_matrix.description: Inhomogeneous deformation gb parameter matrix of size 2 x 4 (total 8 parameters, parity 1)

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [odd: E_eps1_del{k}_pp/pm/mp/mm] < [even: H_k, E_2del{k}_p/m, E_del{i}_del{j}_pp/mm/pm/mp] (K = 1 is excluded)

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: Inhomogeneous deformation 2-cocycle gamma(X, Y) defined by [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb_{sigma, j, s} * kappa

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
